import hashlib, importlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
study = root / 'experiments/hcsn_distribution_content_r15_20261101'
run = study / 'results/formal_03'
freeze = json.loads((run / 'SOURCE_FREEZE.json').read_text())
for relative, expected in freeze['files'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, relative
historical = [study / 'results' / n for n in ('formal_01', 'formal_02', 'formal_03')]
historical += [study / 'development' / n for n in ('development01', 'development02')]
for location in historical:
    registered = json.loads((location / 'SOURCE_FREEZE.json').read_text())
    for relative, expected in registered['files'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((location / 'source_snapshot' / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, (location, relative)
modules = {name[:-3].replace('/', '.').removesuffix('.__init__') for name in freeze['files']}
prefix = 'experiments.hcsn_distribution_content_r15_20261101.'
modules.update(prefix + name for name in ('online_confirm', 'train_execution_cross', 'write_tail_evidence', 'publication.pack_results', 'publication.build_report', 'publication.plot_results', 'publication.runtime_ledger_v3', 'publication.resume_training'))
for name in sorted(modules):
    module = importlib.import_module(name)
    assert Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root), (name, module.__file__)
for directory, filename in (('full_online_confirmation', 'online_confirm.py'), ('train_execution_cross', 'train_execution_cross.py')):
    registration = json.loads((run / directory / 'SELF_REGISTRATION.json').read_text())
    assert hashlib.sha256((run / directory / registration['source_snapshot']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == registration['source_sha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256((study / filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == registration['source_sha256']
import numpy, scipy, torch, mpmath, matplotlib
print(json.dumps({'scope': 'source hashes and imports only; no dataset/model execution or result inspection', 'local_modules_imported': len(modules), 'historical_snapshots_checked': sum(len(json.loads((p / 'SOURCE_FREEZE.json').read_text())['files']) for p in historical), 'versions': {'numpy': numpy.__version__, 'scipy': scipy.__version__, 'torch': torch.__version__, 'mpmath': mpmath.__version__, 'matplotlib': matplotlib.__version__}}))
